summary: 111, Inc. (NASDAQ: YI), a Chinese tech-enabled healthcare platform, filed a 6-K disclosing the board's establishment of a three-member Special Committee of independent directors — Jian Sun (chair), Nee Chuan Teo and Jun Luo — to evaluate the previously announced September 16, 2026 preliminary, non-binding proposal and other strategic alternatives. No price, stake, premium or definitive terms were disclosed; the board cautioned no decisions have been made and there is no assurance any definitive offer or agreement will result. Watch for a going-private or competing bid, advisor appointments and any revised proposal; risk-arb hinges on whether a binding offer emerges.
